search_space: The program exhaustively enumerates all 64 subsets of S3 to identify subgroups and all 32 subsets of S3 \ Z(S3) to identify maximal independent sets, then checks every integer m in {1,2,3,4,5,6}.
refutation_explanation: For m=1, |Z(S3)|=1, so m is permitted. The three transpositions are three distinct maximal independent singleton sets, hence m.i.s.(S3,1)=3. No subgroup has cardinality 0, hence m.a.s.(S3,0)=0; therefore 3 ≠ 0.
